BootstrapBlazor.Server.Components.Sample.BaiduOcrDesc: This component performs VAT invoice text recognition by calling the Baidu AI OCR API. It supports structured recognition of all fields for VAT ordinary invoices, special invoices, fully electronic invoices, roll invoices, and blockchain invoices, including basic invoice information, seller and purchaser information, commodity information, and tax details. The recognition accuracy of the five key fields exceeds 99.9%. Images uploaded must not exceed 4 MB.
